title: 3dttest++
description: Gosset (Student) t-test of sets of 3D datasets in AFNI

setA.description: Set A in short form, e.g., 'a+tlrc[3]' b+tlrc[3] ...'
setA.title: -setA

setB.description: Set B in short form, e.g., 'x+tlrc[3]' y+tlrc[3] ...'
setB.title: -setB

setA_long.description: Specify an overall name for the set of datasets (Long form). Example: -setA Green sub001 a+tlrc[3] sub002 b+tlrc[3] ...
setA_long.title: -setA (Long Form)

setB_long.description: Specify an overall name for the set of datasets (Long form). Example: -setB Blue sub001 x+tlrc[3] sub002 y+tlrc[3] ...
setB_long.title: -setB (Long Form)

labelA.description: Label for the set (for Set A). Limited to 12 characters.
labelA.title: -labelA

labelB.description: Label for the set (for Set B). Limited to 12 characters.
labelB.title: -labelB

setweightA.description: File with voxel-wise weights for -setA datasets.
setweightA.title: -setweightA

setweightB.description: File with voxel-wise weights for -setB datasets.
setweightB.title: -setweightB

prefix.description: Output the prefix name of the dataset result. For surface-based datasets, use -prefix p.niml.dset or -prefix p.gii.dset
prefix.title: -prefix

resid.description: Residuals will be output into a dataset with the given prefix.
resid.title: -resid

paired.description: Specify to use a paired-sample t-test to compare setA and setB. Both sets must have the same cardinality.
paired.title: -paired

unpooled.description: Specify separate variance estimates for setA and setB (not pooled together).
unpooled.title: -unpooled

exblur.description: Add extra Gaussian blurring kernel FWHM (mm). Example: -exblur 6
exblur.title: -exblur

randomsign.description: Randomize signs of datasets. Used with output from -resid to generate null hypothesis statistics.
randomsign.title: -randomsign

permute.description: With -randomsign, adds inter-set permutation to randomization when both sets are used.
permute.title: -permute

ETAC.description: Apply the Equitable Thresholding And Clustering (ETAC) method for thresholding results.
ETAC.title: -ETAC

ETAC_blur.description: List of multiple levels of spatial blurring for ETAC. Example: -ETAC_blur 4 6
ETAC_blur.title: -ETAC_blur
